page.notes: The "«" marks in the right margin are printed quotation-style marks, one per line of the column; they are recorded as notes at the line ends. The printed "uerò" is written "verò" under the u/v rule. The word "perti-net," is split across the line end and rejoined with its printed hyphen. The signature "b 5" has a final figure that resembles a yogh, so it is marked [?]. The running head's central letter is stylised and is marked [?].
